cases.summary: Bug: Unable to copy fiat amount in Invoice Checkout
cases.description: Clicking on the fiat amount copy `NaN` in the clipboard (Total Fiat and Exchange Rate)

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix clipboard copy for fiat amounts and other numeric values
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix clipboard copy for fiat amounts and other numeric values

Convert asNumber() results to strings using optional chaining and toString() to fix clipboard copy functionality. Previously, numeric values were being copied as 'NaN' because data-clipboard attribute expected strings.

Fixes #6933
